title: Hardcoded rgba() hex colors remain in NewStartPage
body: Several rgba() and hex hardcoded colors remain in NewStartPage/index.tsx (e.g., rgba(14,165,233,0.2), rgba(168,85,247,0.2), #0ea5e9 inline). These were not part of the review scope but should be migrated to CSS variables for full design system compliance.
rationale: Review feedback was scoped to gradient violations only. rgba() background decorations were not flagged but are technically hardcoded colors that bypass the design token system.
